_comment: Live GET /v1/artists/{id}/albums?include_groups=album,single&limit=10, no market parameter, recorded by npm run fixtures:record. limit=10 is the real ceiling here: 20 and above return 400 "Invalid limit", unlike /me/following which allows 50. Keyed by artist id. Re-record when the upstream shape changes; the diff names what broke.
